Ben / Kim / Susan / Procurement —

Attached is a compact econ workbook (creo_econ_v2.xlsx) and the one-pager text below for procurement. High level assumptions used in the workbook:

- Baseline tokens/session: median 3,200 tokens, 95th 6,800 tokens (we used a 4k avg for modeling).
- Sessions/day (POC): conservative 300 sessions/day -> ~1.2M tokens/day.
- Raw tokens per $ (no batching, no cache): 200k tokens/$ (this is the same conservative baseline Ben used).

Batching & caching sensitivity (high level):
- No batching, no cache: cost = baseline (1.2M tokens / 200k) = $6.00/day -> ~$180/month for POC
- Avg batching 3 reqs (RPC-level batching): effective tokens per $ improves ~1.9x -> cost ~ $3.15/day
- Avg batching 6 reqs: ~2.6x improvement -> cost ~ $2.30/day
- Cache hit 25% (prefix/KV cache): saves ~25% of tokens on average; combined with batching (3 reqs) net cost ~ $2.35/day

Pilot cap suggestions (we commonly offer tiered caps for healthcare POCs):
- Small cap: 200k tokens/month (smoke test) — complimentary with engineering support (capped trial)
- Medium cap: 5M tokens/month — $X flat + overage at baseline rate (example pricing in workbook)
- Large cap: 20M tokens/month — discounted cap + graduated overage thresholds tied to batch+cache metrics

Procurement one-pager (paste text for contract):
- POC scope: Redwood hosted inference for CreoHealth test environment; expected POC duration 30 days starting Nov 15.
- Acceptance: Successful demo with 300 sessions/day and model responses meeting accuracy checklist (attached to MAP).
- Unit econ gating: 3 checkpoints during POC (week 1, week 2, week 4) to evaluate effective tokens/$ under observed caching and batching behaviors. Threshold for acceptance to proceed to paid pilot: observed effective tokens/$ <= 120k tokens per $ (equivalent to ~ $8.33 per 1M tokens).
- Pilot commercial: propose Medium cap (5M tokens/month) during pilot with overage at baseline rate; include auto-rollback to smaller cap if batch/hit assumptions are not met after checkpoints.
- Data controls: default POC TTL for prefix cache is 12 hours; caching limited to non-PHI fields by default. By default, no PHI is retained in long-term logs; short-term operational traces (24h) may temporarily include request hashes for debugging; full text logs are disabled unless both parties sign-off.

Action items from us by EOD Fri (I've attached the workbook):
- Ben: send the one-pager to procurement as a clean PDF (I placed the procurement language in the workbook).
- Kim: confirm recommended engineering support window (eng headcount estimate and gating cadence).
- Ben/Susan: confirm POC start and cap tier selection.
